mapper.select: SELECT policy_id, policy_name, description, conditions, effect, priority, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM policies WHERE policy_name = #{policyName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO policies ( policy_name, description, conditions, effect, priority, enabled ) VALUES ( #{policyName}, #{description}, #{conditions}, #{effect}, #{priority}, #{enabled} )
mapper.update: UPDATE policies SET description = #{description}, conditions = #{conditions}, effect = #{effect}, priority = #{priority}, enabled = #{enabled} WHERE policy_id = #{policyId}
